common_requirements: Create a playable 3D game demo with a controllable humanoid player, one humanoid melee boss, and a connected environment for free exploration and combat. Support movement, melee attacks, dodging, readable attack anticipation, hit reactions, and encounter reset. Keep the combat space unobstructed and all intended exploration routes traversable.

cases.title: Sunlit Mediterranean Courtyard
cases.scene_prompt: Build a sunlit Mediterranean courtyard with warm limestone walls, blue wooden doors, terracotta pots, and climbing vines. Connect a central combat plaza to a shaded arcade and a small fountain garden using short, level paths. A lightly armored traveler faces a bronze town sentinel. Use warm daylight, soft shadows, and clearly differentiated stone, wood, and metal.

cases.title: Gothic Cathedral Quarter

cases.title: Dense Cyberpunk Neon District
cases.scene_prompt: Build a dense cyberpunk district after rain, with abundant neon advertisements, layered signs, futuristic storefronts, rooftop equipment, and a varied high-rise skyline. Connect a market combat plaza to a narrow food alley, an elevated transit entrance, and a lower repair depot. Include a parked hover vehicle, an autonomous cargo rover, and charging stations. A cyber courier faces an armored security enforcer. Balance vivid advertising with readable surfaces and localized wet-road reflections.

cases.title: Underwater Research Habitat
cases.scene_prompt: Build a sealed underwater research habitat with curved observation windows, pressure doors, laboratory equipment, cable conduits, and modular metal interiors. Connect a dry central docking-hall combat area to a glass observation gallery, a maintenance bay, and an upper control room. A marine engineer faces a humanoid pressure-suit guardian. Show ocean water, coral, and structural supports outside the windows; combine cool exterior light with warm interior fixtures while keeping all gameplay inside dry, traversable spaces.
